finding: G's HEAD CANNOT BEAT A LOOKUP TABLE ON v2 EITHER — because the state it reads is a function of a prompt that contains only the symptom.

the_proof_is_counting_not_modelling.why: at the first hypothesis the prompt is SYSTEM + 'SYMPTOM: <s>' + the four region names + the budget. History is empty and nothing is inspected, so the ONLY content that varies across tasks is the symptom string. Two tasks with the same symptom have byte-identical prompts, hence identical activations at every layer, hence identical head output. A head on that state IS a six-row lookup table on the symptom -- not approximately, exactly.
the_proof_is_counting_not_modelling.and the agent really does decide there: 72 of 80 episodes hypothesise at STEP 1 with ZERO inspects; the other 8 inspect twice first. So the decision point G was specified for is, in 90% of episodes, a point at which no program text has been revealed.

the_ceiling_this_imposes.reading: G's head can reach 61.2% at absolute best, and a dict reaches it for free. On v1 the table was PERFECT (100%) so G was untestable because the ceiling was free. On v2 the table is imperfect, but G cannot see anything the table cannot -- same conclusion, different arithmetic.

what_would_make_G_testable: (a) require an inspect before the first hypothesis, so the decision prompt carries revealed program text. A HARNESS change, not a task-set change -- 理's comparability constraint is about the loop, so this needs an explicit ruling.
(b) put the program in the decision prompt from the start, which changes what the AGENT sees as well as what the head reads, and would need a new baseline.
(c) accept the ceiling and test only whether the head reaches 61.2% -- which measures nothing worth a GPU-hour, because a dict already does.
what_this_does_NOT_invalidate: the v2 task set is fine: its localisation axis is genuinely non-degenerate (P1/P2/P3 all pass, held-out table 51.2% not 100%). The defect is in WHERE G reads, not in what v2 asks. v2 stays; the decision point has to move.
bounds: 80 eval tasks. The 6-prompt count is exact for them; over all 2,000 v2 tasks there are 6 distinct symptoms, so it is 6 there too.

This assumes the head reads the state at the decision position of the step-1 prompt, which is what et8_head_region.py does and what the G plan specifies. A head reading teacher-forced CANDIDATE prefixes still conditions on the same prompt and inherits the same ceiling.
It says nothing about whether activations encode useful structure in general -- only that at THIS decision point there is nothing for them to encode beyond the symptom.
